Jackknife influence values

Source: R/bootstrap.R
jackknife_influence.Rd

Leave-one-out (jackknife) estimates of the empirical influence values of a statistic, \(L_i = (n - 1)(\bar\theta_{(\cdot)} - \hat\theta_{(i)})\).

jackknife_influence(data, statistic)

Arguments

data

A numeric vector, data frame or matrix. Resampling is over elements (vectors) or rows (data frames and matrices).

statistic

A function taking resampled data and returning a single number.

Value

A numeric vector of length n.

Examples

jackknife_influence(c(1, 4, 2, 8, 5), mean)
#> [1] -3  0 -2  4  1
